theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 2 群

items.pos: n. 內容 | adj. 滿意的
items.colloc: content marketing 內容行銷 | table of contents 目錄
items.distinct: context 語境；上下文 | container 容器
ex: The report has valuable content for our team.
這份報告對我們團隊有珍貴的內容。
She seems content with the current salary.
她似乎對目前的薪水感到滿意。
Please review the content of the contract.
請檢視這份合約的內容。

items.pos: n. 遞送；交付；演說風格
items.colloc: delivery service 配送服務 | free delivery 免運費
items.distinct: distribution 分配；配銷 | shipment 裝運的貨物
ex: We expect the delivery by tomorrow afternoon.
我們預計明天下午收到貨物。
His delivery of the presentation was excellent.
他這次簡報的表達方式很出色。
The store offers free delivery on all orders.
該店提供所有訂單免費配送。

items.pos: n. 部門；系
items.colloc: accounting department 會計部 | HR department 人力資源部
items.distinct: sector 行業；領域 | division 部門；分公司
ex: Our department is hiring a new assistant.
我們部門正在徵求一位新助理。
Please contact the marketing department directly.
請直接聯繫行銷部門。
Every department must submit a budget report.
每個部門都必須提交預算報告。

items.pos: n. 影響；衝擊 | v. 產生影響
items.colloc: have an impact on 對...有影響 | major impact 重大影響
items.distinct: influence 影響力（較長遠）| effect 結果；效果
ex: The new policy had a major impact on sales.
新政策對銷售額產生了重大影響。
Rising costs will impact our annual profit.
成本上升將影響我們的年度利潤。
We need to assess the environmental impact.
我們需要評估環境影響。

items.pos: n. 收入；所得
items.colloc: annual income 年收入 | disposable income 可支配收入
items.distinct: salary 薪水（定期）| revenue 營收（企業）
ex: She is looking for a steady source of income.
她正在尋找穩定的收入來源。
High income earners pay higher taxes.
高收入者繳納較高的稅金。
The company generates income from digital ads.
該公司透過數位廣告獲利。

items.pos: adj. 當地的；本地的 | n. 當地人
items.colloc: local business 本地企業 | local market 當地市場
items.distinct: regional 地區的 | domestic 國內的
ex: We decided to hire a local supplier.
我們決定僱用一家當地供應商。
The event attracted many local residents.
這場活動吸引了許多當地居民。
Support local businesses in your community.
請支持你社區裡的在地企業。

items.pos: adj. 專業的；職業的 | n. 專業人士
items.colloc: professional advice 專業建議 | professional development 職業發展
items.distinct: vocational 職業技術的 | expert 專家
ex: You should maintain a professional attitude.
你應該保持專業的態度。
She is a professional in the accounting field.
她是會計領域的專業人士。
We offer professional training for employees.
我們為員工提供專業訓練。

items.pos: adv. 嚴格地；完全地
items.colloc: strictly prohibited 嚴格禁止 | strictly followed 嚴格遵守
items.distinct: severely 嚴重地 | precisely 精確地
ex: Smoking is strictly prohibited in the office.
辦公室內嚴格禁止抽菸。
The budget must be strictly followed.
預算必須被嚴格遵守。
These rules are strictly enforced by management.
管理層嚴格執行這些規則。

items.pos: adj. 清晰的；明確的 | v. 清除
items.colloc: clear instruction 明確指示 | clear understanding 清晰的理解
items.distinct: vivid 生動的 | transparent 透明的
ex: Please give me a clear explanation of this.
請對此給我一個明確的解釋。
The path needs to be cleared of snow.
這條路需要清除積雪。
It is clear that we need more staff.
顯然我們需要更多員工。

items.pos: v. 說服；使確信
items.colloc: convince someone to do 說服某人做某事 | convince someone of 說服某人相信
items.distinct: persuade 勸說 | influence 影響
ex: I need to convince my boss to approve it.
我需要說服老闆批准這件事。
They convinced him of the project's value.
他們使他確信該專案的價值。
Nothing could convince her to change her mind.
沒什麼能說服她改變心意。

items.pos: n. 地區；領域；範圍
items.colloc: waiting area 等候區 | area of expertise 專長領域
items.distinct: region 地區（較大）| zone 區域（特定用途）
ex: The conference will be held in this area.
會議將在此地區舉辦。
She is an expert in the area of finance.
她是金融領域的專家。
Please keep the work area clean at all times.
請隨時保持工作區域整潔。

items.pos: v. 按；壓 | n. 新聞界；印刷
items.colloc: press release 新聞稿 | press conference 記者會
items.distinct: push 推 | squeeze 擠壓
ex: Press the green button to start the machine.
按下綠色按鈕啟動機器。
The press reported on the merger today.
媒體今天報導了這項合併案。
We will issue a press release next week.
我們下週將發布新聞稿。

items.pos: v. 宣布；公告
items.colloc: announce the results 宣布結果 | officially announce 正式宣布
items.distinct: declare 宣告 | publish 發布（出版品）
ex: The manager announced the new company policy.
經理宣布了新的公司政策。
They will announce the winner tomorrow morning.
他們將於明早宣布獲勝者。
An email was sent to announce the change.
一封電子郵件被發出以宣布變更。

items.pos: adj. 出席的；現在的 | v. 呈現；簡報
items.colloc: present at the meeting 出席會議 | present an idea 提出想法
items.distinct: current 目前的 | offer 提供
ex: Most of the staff were present today.
大部分員工今天都有出席。
I need to present my proposal to the board.
我需要向董事會簡報我的提案。
He presented a summary of the quarterly report.
他呈現了季報的摘要。

items.pos: n. 紀錄；唱片 | v. /rɪˈkɔːrd/ 錄音；記載
items.colloc: keep a record 做紀錄 | set a record 破紀錄
items.distinct: log 日誌 | file 檔案
ex: Please keep a record of all your expenses.
請保留所有費用的紀錄。
The meeting will be recorded for later review.
會議將被錄音以便日後檢閱。
Our team set a new sales record this month.
我們團隊本月創下了新的銷售紀錄。

items.pos: n. 地址；演說 | v. 處理；對...演說
items.colloc: mailing address 通訊地址 | address the issue 處理問題
items.distinct: location 地點 | deal with 處理
ex: Please confirm your office address with us.
請與我們確認你的辦公室地址。
We need to address these concerns immediately.
我們需要立即處理這些疑慮。
The CEO will address the employees tomorrow.
執行長明天將對員工發表演說。

items.pos: v. 增加 | n. /ˈɪnkriːs/ 增長
items.colloc: increase in price 價格上漲 | significant increase 顯著增長
items.distinct: rise 上升 | expand 擴張
ex: We hope to increase sales by ten percent.
我們希望銷售額能增加百分之十。
There has been an increase in customer demand.
客戶需求出現了增長。
Rising demand will increase our production costs.
需求上升將增加我們的生產成本。

items.pos: v. 允許；准許 | n. /ˈpɜːrmɪt/ 許可證
items.colloc: work permit 工作許可證 | permit someone to do 允許某人做
items.distinct: allow 允許 | authorize 授權
ex: The rules do not permit personal calls here.
規定不允許在這裡打私人電話。
You need a parking permit to use this lot.
你需要停車證才能使用這個停車場。
Weather permitting, we will hold the event.
若天氣允許，我們將舉辦該活動。

items.pos: v. 攪拌；引起（情緒/活動）
items.colloc: stir up 激起；挑起 | create a stir 引起轟動
items.distinct: mix 混合 | incite 煽動
ex: Please stir the mixture until it is smooth.
請將混合物攪拌至平滑。
The new announcement stirred a lot of interest.
這項新公告引起了極大興趣。
His comments created a stir among the staff.
他的評論在員工中引起了轟動。

items.pos: n. 主題；科目 | adj. 受支配的 | v. 使服從
items.colloc: change the subject 轉換話題 | subject to change 可能會變動
items.distinct: topic 話題 | theme 主旨
ex: The subject of the meeting is the new budget.
會議的主題是關於新預算。
This schedule is subject to change without notice.
此行程表若有變更恕不另行通知。
English is a required subject for all students.
英文是所有學生的必修科目。
